notes.title: PAW Patrol: Grand Prix - Pup Treat Arena DLC | Launch Trailer
notes.content:
It's party time at the #PAWPatrolGrandPrix! 
Join Ryder & your pup pals in battles at 3 iconic PAW Patrol locations: Adventure Bay, the Jungle, and Jake's Snowboard Resort. 

Play in local co-pup mode with up to 3 friends and compete to collect the most pup treats before the time runs out. 

No pup is too small to win in this racing party! Up for the challenge? 

#PAWPatrolPupTreatArena DLC is out now. 

[previewyoutube=l4hcMfLEFRM;full][/previewyoutube]

Learn more👉 https://bit.ly/PawPatrolGPDLC
